text: 据央视财经，MSCI中国指数季度调样正式生效。33只股票被纳入，32只股票被调出。此前，当地时间8月12日，明晟公司（MSCI）公布了MSCI股票指数2026年8月指数审议结果，调整于8月31日收盘后生效。 在本次调整中，MSCI中国指数新纳入智谱、鼎泰高科等33只股票，同时剔除万科A、永辉超市等32只股票。本次新纳入的33只标的涵盖半导体、AI、医药、新材料、精密制造等多个前沿领域。 值得关注的是，本次有10家科创板公司新晋跻身MSCI中国指数，其中7家来自半导体产业链，覆盖芯片设计、制造封测、设备、材料等全环节，凸显出中国硬科技板块在全球资本市场中的
text_en: According to CCTV Finance, the MSCI China Index quarterly rebalancing has officially taken effect. 33 stocks were added and 32 stocks were removed. Previously, on Aug 12 local time, MSCI announced the results of its August 2026 index review, effective after the market close on Aug 31. In this adjustment, the MSCI China Index newly included 33 stocks such as Zhipu and Dingtai Precision, while removing 32 stocks including Vanke A and Yonghui Superstores. The 33 newly added targets cover multiple frontier fields including semiconductors, AI, pharmaceuticals, new materials, and precision manufacturing. Notably, 10 STAR Market companies joined the MSCI China Index this time, with 7 from the semiconductor supply chain, covering chip design, manufacturing and packaging testing, equipment, and materials across all segments, highlighting the position of China's hard tech sector in the global capital market.
